crm-updater.name: CRM updater
crm-updater.description: Reviews recent Gmail conversations and applies evidence-backed updates to matching Attio contacts.

connections.purpose: Read recent received and sent email conversations.
connections.setup_notes: Connect the Gmail account whose prospect and business conversations should be reviewed.

connections.purpose: Find matching people and update contact attributes supported by email evidence.
connections.setup_notes: Connect the Attio workspace that contains the people records to maintain.

automations.name: Daily CRM email review

messages.content: Run the daily Gmail-to-Attio contact review now. Review the preceding 24 hours, prepare exact evidence-backed updates, and stop for my approval without writing or sending anything.

automations.setup_notes: This recipe is inactive when loaded. Confirm the 09:00 UTC schedule, timezone, 24-hour review window, and whether the run should use automatic or approval-first updates before enabling it.
